timing_contract.ttft: request start through first generated token copied to host; includes tokenization, prompt H2D transfer, and prefill
timing_contract.prompt_h2d: Reactant.to_rarray of the runtime prompt token matrix, measured inside every request

source.description: Exact no-thinking Qwen3 prompts for a cache-busted 14B E2E comparison. The first Chinese character is one tokenizer token and changes for every performance request, preventing cross-request prefix-cache reuse.

phase_plan.scheduling: one request per case in JSON order after XLA compilation
phase_plan.cold_definition: first post-compilation request; load, transfer, and XLA compile are reported separately
phase_plan.semantic_smoke_policy: execute when token length matches the compiled performance shape; otherwise record a skip and use the canonical single-prompt result for semantic verification

case_results.skip_reason: semantic_smoke has 17 prompt tokens, but the compiled performance shape requires 18; semantic verification is covered by the canonical single-prompt benchmark result
case_results.name: canonical
